title: Tools: Switch to a new Windows development artifact repository.
description:
Download our third party libraries and drivers from
dev-artifacts.wireshark.org in win-setup.ps1. Automatically check our
state based on our library filenames and hashes.

----

This currently downloads from a PoC GitLab Pages site at https://geraldcombs.gitlab.io/wireshark-development-libraries/, which is built from https://gitlab.com/geraldcombs/wireshark-development-libraries/. Before this can be merged, I need to do the following:

* [x] Merge !6934 (remove 32-bit packages from win-setup) and possibly !5319 (unzip using CMake in win-setup).
* [x] Move the repository to the Wireshark organization.
* [x] Publish the site under a wireshark.org URL, e.g. dev-libs.wireshark.org.
* [x] Update this change to use the wireshark.org URL.
* [x] Update docbook/wsdg_src/WSDG_chapter_libraries.adoc.
* [x] Update the wiki if needed.

commits_data.title: Tools: Switch to a new Windows development library repository.
commits_data.message:
Tools: Switch to a new Windows development library repository.

Download our third party libraries and drivers from dev-libs.wireshark.org
in win-setup.ps1. Automatically check our state based on our library
filenames and hashes instead of a manually updated tag.
